  • What is stem cell treatment? Mechanism of regenerative medicine that provides beauty effects
  • Side effects and downtime of regenerative medicine/stem cell treatment

stem cell therapy

Stem cells are cells that have the ability to differentiate into various cells (tissues) (multipotency) and the ability to self-renew. Stem cells are cultured from your own adipose tissue and administered to the entire face. The administered stem cells differentiate into cells of the epidermis, dermis, subcutaneous fat, hair follicles, etc., release skin-beautifying ingredients such as hyaluronic acid, elastin, and collagen, and promote skin regeneration. In addition, stem cells have the ability to be guided to damaged tissues and repair them (homing). Therefore, it has been reported that stem cells administered intravenously have the potential to repair tissues throughout the body. These effects last for several years while the stem cells are engrafted. You can also receive IV treatment for chronic pain at Norris Clinic, a cosmetic dermatology clinic in Osaka.

Click here for details on stem cell treatment

PRP (platelet rich plasma)

Plasma, which contains a large amount of platelets, is separated from your own blood. This plasma contains growth factors called cytokines that induce soft tissue reinforcement, fibroblast activation, and new collagen production, as well as new blood vessel and adipose tissue formation in the skin, promoting skin rejuvenation.

[Osaka] Cosmetic surgery
Click here for details on PRP therapy

Stem cell culture supernatant (exosomes)

The culture medium used to culture stem cells contains large amounts of cytokines and exosomes. This formulation is called stem cell culture supernatant. When administered to the skin, it has the same effect as PRP, and when administered intravenously, it can be expected to have a temporary tissue repair effect. On the other hand, exosomes are tiny intercellular messengers that play a role in directing cells. To put it simply, exosomes are communication tools that act as messengers between cells. These preparations are sometimes called exosomes, but the effects are brought about by both cytokines and exosomes. At Norris Clinic, a beauty clinic in Osaka, you can also create your own supernatant from the culture medium used when culturing stem cells.
